data_output.description: Unchanged current encode(splits) contract: it returns encoded and total dimension. encoded["train"] and encoded["valid"] are (features, labels, users); encoded["test"] is (features, users). features is int32 shape (rows, 5), with columns in exact order user_id, video_id, tab, hour, weekday. All vocabularies are fitted on train only; unseen values use each field's train-fitted unknown index. hour is derived as floor(numeric hourmin / 100) constrained to 0..23, and weekday is calendar weekday from YYYYMMDD date with Monday=0 through Sunday=6.

model_input.description: Model receives the unchanged int32 features matrix and total encoded dimension. It uses features[:,0] for user embedding lookup, features[:,1] for video embedding lookup, and features[:,2:5] exclusively for tab/hour/weekday residual-weight lookup. Labels are supplied only to step(features, labels). logits(features) and predict(features) return one score per input row in input order.

model_designer.objective: Replace the additive user_id and video_id scalar terms in model.py with a rank-16, equal-width user-video embedding interaction scored by one L2-normalized dot product, while retaining only tab, hour, and weekday as additive categorical residual terms plus the global bias.
required_changes: Modify only model.py. Keep the public Model constructor signature as Model(dimension, learning_rate=0.01, l2=1e-6), and keep logits(features), step(features, labels), predict(features, batch_size=200_000), state(), and load_state(state) callable by the existing train.py without changes.

Treat the existing encoded feature matrix columns exactly as produced by data.py: features[:, 0] is the train-fitted encoded user_id index, features[:, 1] is the train-fitted encoded video_id index, and features[:, 2:5] are the train-fitted encoded tab, derived hour, and derived weekday indices respectively. Do not add raw fields, aliases, joins, or derived features.

Use two separate float32 embedding tables, user_embeddings and video_embeddings, each with shape (dimension, 16). Index them with features[:, 0] and features[:, 1]. Initialize both deterministically from np.random.default_rng(0) with small nonzero normal values (for example mean 0 and standard deviation 0.01) so normalized-interaction gradients are nonzero from the first update.

Compute the interaction as exactly one normalized dot product per row: normalize each selected user embedding and video embedding by its rowwise L2 norm with a positive numerical epsilon, then sum the elementwise product of the two normalized vectors. Do not retain any additive scalar user_id or video_id weights and do not add interaction biases, feature crosses, or nonlinear layers.

Add a residual_weights float32 vector of length dimension and compute residual logits only from residual_weights[features[:, 2:5]].sum(axis=1). The complete logit must be bias + normalized_user_video_dot_product + tab_hour_weekday_residual_sum.

Train all three parameter groups with BCE gradients: user_embeddings, video_embeddings, and residual_weights. For each interaction gradient, differentiate through L2 normalization; for an upstream scalar g and normalized vectors u_hat and v_hat, use g*(v_hat - dot*u_hat)/||u|| for the user vector and g*(u_hat - dot*v_hat)/||v|| for the video vector, with the same epsilon-stabilized norms used by the forward computation. Accumulate repeated IDs using np.add.at. Apply the existing l2 value to embedding tables and residual_weights, but preserve the parent behavior of leaving the scalar bias unregularized.

Preserve the parent Adam hyperparameters beta1=0.9, beta2=0.999, epsilon=1e-8, bias-correction behavior, learning-rate use, BCE calculation, float32 parameter storage, finite clipped sigmoid behavior, and batch prediction behavior. Maintain independent first and second Adam moments for each trainable tensor.

Make state() return independent copies of every inference parameter needed for the selected checkpoint: user_embeddings, video_embeddings, residual_weights, and bias. Make load_state(state) restore those inference parameters. Optimizer moments do not need checkpoint restoration because training stops before the selected state is reloaded for prediction.
Ensure logits and predict return a one-dimensional finite score array in the same input row order, including when a prediction batch is processed.
preserve: Keep the data.py encoding and its train-fitted unknown-category behavior unchanged; this task must consume its current five-column encoded matrix without modifying data.py.
Keep BCE as the training loss and preserve the existing trainer-controlled optimizer schedule, split boundaries, validation-only checkpoint selection, and early stopping behavior.
Do not read labels except those supplied to step(). In particular, model.py must not access test labels or implement any test-based selection.
Do not alter the prediction artifact contract implemented by train.py: validation and test scores must remain aligned to their canonical encoded input row order.
coordination_notes: No trainer or feature_engineer changes are needed because model.py must preserve the current constructor and method interfaces and infer field roles from the fixed current feature-column order.

The existing train.py will continue to instantiate Model(dimension, learning_rate=config["learning_rate"], l2=config["l2"]), pass full encoded matrices to step/predict, select checkpoints using validation proxy only, and write predictions_valid.npz and predictions_test.npz.
The rank is deliberately fixed at 16 inside the architecture implementation; config.json is not changed, so no configured value may be added or silently substituted.

reasoning: The requested ablation changes only the scoring architecture: the current encoded columns already provide train-fitted user_id, video_id, tab, canonical hour=floor(numeric hourmin/100) constrained to 0..23, and canonical weekday from date with Monday=0 through Sunday=6. A model-only change can preserve all data, split, optimizer, and output interfaces while removing additive user/video scalar weights. The normalized rank-16 interaction can change within-user item ordering; tab, hour, and weekday remain the only additive residual categorical terms. No forbidden, quarantined, or additional raw field is introduced.
